idle.small: Rendered below 48px: breathe + blink only (no steam, no hat sway).

idle.sync: All Topfberts on screen share one clock (same animation-delay from a shared start time), so several of them never blink out of step.

tour.mirror: pointing only: flip the whole element with transform: scaleX(-1). The 140 viewBox is symmetric around x 70, so the box does not move; layer pivots mirror along. Never flip single layers. Nothing in the drawing is one-sided (no lettering, no directional light, no steam).
tour.small: Rendered below 48px: breathe + blink only. No steam layers, no hat motion, no wave / nudge / tip; the arm stays in its drawn position. Mirroring still applies.
tour.reducedMotion: No loop and no blink. Show frame 0 (the full SVG as exported). Pause when < 50% visible, under a sheet/dialog, or in the background.
tour.theme: One drawing for light and dark. Outline stays #1F1E1C; only the steam rods take the text colour (#1F1E1C / #F3EFE8), as in R11 idle.

placement.side: tail in the right half (target centre x ≥ 50% of screen width) → Topfbert left of the bubble, as drawn; else right, mirrored
placement.vertical: Topfbert bottom edge = bubble bottom edge, whether the bubble is above or below its target
placement.overlap: Topfbert stands 10 px over the bubble edge, in front of it (z above bubble); bubble padding 15 18 17 24 (24 on his side)
placement.width: bubble = screen − 24 (12 px margins) − 54 → 282 px at 360; max 320
placement.aboveOrBelow: target centre in the lower half → bubble above, else below; if it does not fit between target and safe area, use the other side
placement.tail: 12 px square rotated 45°, radius 2, centred on the target-facing edge; x = target centre clamped to 28 px from the bubble corners; tip 8 px from the spotlight ring
placement.spotlight: color-scrim over the screen, hole = target rect + 6 px, radius + 6, ring 3 px #F7B94A (static)
placement.noTarget: waving / wink: full scrim, no hole, no tail; group bottom 40 px above the safe area (clear of the FAB)
placement.bubble: light surface #FFFFFF, dark surface-muted #2A2825, radius 24 22 26 22, shadow-dialog; title Petrona 500 21/1.15, text Figtree 500 15/1.4 (text-muted)
